overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not anticipate discussing the continuance motion 48 hours before the meeting. The other two allegations were declined for review.

allegations.summary: Board allegedly discussed a motion for a continuance at a January meeting even though the topic was not listed on the meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: While it may be true that the possibility of the need for a continuance was generally known, the chair did not anticipate discussing a motion for a continuance at the January 5 meeting until the day prior.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the board chair made untrue statements during the January meeting.
allegations.key_passage: we do not review statements made by public body members to determine their veracity.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the board discussed his character and reputation in open session rather than in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: the body is not obligated to do so, and may discuss those issues in open session.
